articles.title: Letter: the Lower Millrace Improvement Group Did a Good Job This Winter
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the February meeting.
Please keep the stormwater drain repair in the budget. Many of us on Kiln Court use it every week.
Marcus Salazar, Upper Commons
